full_page.content:
1931, December 3
Wanda Urbanick God bless you Wanda U. Courage is half the battle - Don't lose it ...... Come over and see me.
Fr. Sol., OM.Cap.
1933, March 4
Wanda Urbanick God bless you Wanda ... Bus ..? Better come over till I pull your ears ... staying away - worring ..? Courage ... Trust in God !...!
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
1935, May 4
Wanda Urbanick - for peace of mind - God bless you Wanda ... But? Come .. stop the worry. O how short is a million years !!!
Fr. Solanus, O.M.Cap.
1943, June 15
Mrs. Anna Urbanick - For guidance and perseverance - Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
Photo of Fr. Solanus -
Front Like the Flowers of Autumn Fr. Sol.
So Do We Fade
Back
Blessed be God in all his designs
God's holy protection guidance for the New Year
and after.
Fr. Solanus, O.F.M.Cap.
